page.overview:
Who is Aikreonian?

The Aikreonians are race that are under threat from the Viltrumites.

Nothing much is known of the Aikreonians except they have been targeted by the Viltrumites, not long after joining the Coalition of Planets. As a result, they cut off all communications.
